locators: Chapter5 p75 Eq5.3 and p76 Eq5.11
findings: The fitted latent mean contains a free common intercept mu and moderator slope beta_1m.
Section5.2.2 assigns mu a normal prior; AppendixD line84 explicitly samples mu.
Section5.3 fixes mu=0 for data generation, which does not constrain the fitted model to mu=0.
conclusion: The free-common-mean assumption of the all-zero-response likelihood counterexample is supported by the source model. No change to that ordinary mathematical argument is required.
limitations: The argument concerns existence of a finite likelihood maximum for a possible degenerate response dataset; it does not establish multiple interior maxima in the observed source samples.
A proper prior changes the posterior objective. This is not a claim of posterior impropriety or Bayesian nonidentification.
method: Read source text for the explicit mean parameterization, prior and AppendixD code; no numerical refit.
